title: Meeting The Mandalorian
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: After finding his way into the hands of Nikto mercenaries, Grogu is discovered by the Mandalorian after a noisy firefight. Though it seems like a mercenary job to start, there's a connection between the two of them that the Mandalorian can't explain. This moment is the beginning of something much bigger than either of them realize.
